description: Add one piece of equipment to the maintenance register: its name, its serial or asset tag, where it lives, and the currency its costs are in. Returns the AST-YYYY-NNNN id. Free tier: 3 assets; logging work on the assets you have is never metered.

currency.description: ISO code the costs are in. Default USD

location.description: Where the asset lives, e.g. Workshop bay 2, or 14 Nowa Street, flat 3

name.description: What the asset is called, e.g. Lathe, Combi boiler, Van 2, or Studio camera A

notes.description: Anything worth keeping with the asset, e.g. Model, warranty end, supplier

tag.description: The serial number or asset tag, e.g. SN-88-4412. Unique across the register: a second asset with the same tag is refused

name: asset_add
title: Add an asset to the register
